title: American Solution for Simplifying the Estate Tax Act of 2014
short_title: American Solution for Simplifying the Estate Tax Act of 2014

actions.text: Referred to the House Committee on Ways and Means.
Sponsor introductory remarks on measure. (CR E1807-1808)

latest_action.text: Sponsor introductory remarks on measure. (CR E1807-1808)

summaries.text: American Solution for Simplifying the Estate Tax Act of 2014 - Amends the Internal Revenue to: (1) allow taxpayers an election to make annual payments of 1% of their adjusted gross income for a minimum seven-year period in lieu of existing estate and generation-skipping transfer taxes, and (2) allow a step-up in basis for estate property of a taxpayer making an election under this Act. Sets forth requirements for the filing of an estate tax return for taxpayers who have made an election under this Act.
